notes.title: Rogue Invader - Version 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/60a20bedb923774a61995259979d3842b730f506.png[/img]
[h1]Rogue Invader v1.1 is finally here![/h1]

[h2]Difficulty Options![/h2]
You now have two difficulty options, Normal and Hard (the original way Rogue Invader shipped). Feedback was pretty clear that Rogue Invader was just too hard. That was a fair critique. We went through and re-factored everything for a normal less punishing experience. Let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/a56f03086faf0f74f570563f652fb0206fcec15b.png[/img]

[h2]Hack Bots in Combat![/h2]

If you are carrying the [b]Combat Toolbox[/b] OR have the [b]MacGyver[/b] trait, not only can you repair weapons and armor, but you can hack enemy turrets and bots and make them fight for [b]YOU[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/3a65c494bd7e297ce2de17110bac6115950f7b73.png[/img]

[h2]Improved Tutorial Level![/h2]

Made some changes to the tutorial level that should makes things clearer about the mechanics of the game. Following the instructions will give you a definite edge starting out for the first time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/c02cd2e3f9515ad2f42c6bd849b9171725252a47.png[/img]

[h2]Global Adjustments and Bug Stomping (of course)![/h2]

[list]
[*] [b][u]Big Tech[/u][/b] and [b][u]More Like Crap Dragon AMIRITE![/u][/b] Steam Achievements for should now properly register.
[*] Added [b]Tooltip[/b] in inventory screen when holding [b]Combat Toolbox[/b] or having the [b]MacGyver trait[/b].
[*] Updated Valhalla help screens when hovering over [b][?][/b] icon in corners of screens.
[*] [b]Hazardous Surface Conditions[/b] now spawn less often in the early game.
[*] During [b]Ion Storms[/b], lengthened the time between lightning strikes.
[*] [b]Factory Level[/b] shortened significantly. It was too long for an end game level with all that we throw at you. Plus conveyors and pits… fun times!
[*] Other various bug fixes that only make the game more [b]awesome![/b]
[/list]

[h3]Thank you for all your support and patience.
We hope you continually find Rogue Invader a [b]fun retro challenge![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Rogue Invader - Update 1.0.32
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/fee443b6087ba6a539f0e07a6883548eba6c5fa0.png[/img]

[u][b]Upscale Graphics Fix[/b][/u]

This update addresses the common graphic issue where the game wold not properly upscale the graphics causing very noticeable flickering and image tearing through-out. This update should eliminate this issue all together. We will be updating the Graphic fix instruction to coincide with this update on the Steam discussions.

[b][u]Balance Changes[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Slightly lowered cost for Barrier Shield Disruptor
[*] Slightly lowered cost for Terran Rifle
[*] Slightly lowered cost for Grenade Slot Upgrade
[*] Slightly lowered enemy spawns from early game locations
[*] Lowered Zeno HP by 1
[*] Increased Player Base HP by 1
[*] Added higher chance to spawn better loot tech in early game
[*] Clues to Surface Battery Entrance are more visible
[/list]

[u][b]Various Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where context menu interactions would not render after landing from anti-gravity grenades.
[*] Identified a possible issue causing lift to Terrace transition to get stuck. Implemented a safety fix.
[*] Identified a possible issue causing entrance to Factory transition to get stuck. Implemented a safety fix.
[*] Terran Heavy overheat behavior now matches the behavior of other Terran weapons.
[*] Non-Shield Terran helmets and armor no longer show Shield Upgrade HP on the battle report.
[/list]

Let us know what you think about the balance changes, especially in the early game. This should make it not as grindy and difficult, while maintaining the challenge. Thank you, and happy invading!

notes.title: Rogue Invader - Update 1.0.31
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39146656/fee443b6087ba6a539f0e07a6883548eba6c5fa0.png[/img]

We got a good amount of fixes and adjustments for any curious invaders. Read on for the full intel.

[b][u]Balance Changes[/u][/b]

[b]NOTE FROM CREATOR:[/b] The cost of all items, armors, upgrades, and weapons has been re-balanced across the entire game. My original goal for Rogue Invader was to have it be a good challenge, but not requiring too much grind. At release, I and the internal testing team felt it good. But initial feedback had us go back and look at the game progression. Costs seemed a little too grindy, and so I've gone through and lowered everything. This should allow players to experiment with more of the items, weapons, and airstrikes without breaking the bank. I hope this change will make for a more fun experience overall. Don't worry, for those that liked the higher priced items, and steeper difficulty because of them, we have HARD difficulty planned for a future DLC.

[b][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where game would crash trying to spawn the corpse of the previous soldier.
[*] Turrets no longer switch back to attacking the player if they've already been hacked. No double agents allowed!
[*] [b]Auto-Beam[/b] modded weapons now properly beam the weapon back to the fleet.
[*] Deaths by Turret are now tracked in the soldier archives.
[*] Fixed rare issue where [b]"Don't Feed the Wildlife"[/b] achievement would not trigger.
[*] [b]Shield Strength Upgrade[/b] now unlocks when fully researching Zeno Staff. Will unlock for players that have already fully researched the Zeno Staff. This also allows for achieving 100% research (73/73).
[*] Shooting King Zeno with an Anti-Matter or Freeze modded weapon now properly triggers the end game cut-scene.
[*] Fixed issue where research was carrying over between profiles
[*] Intermittent transition issue from Fortress to Underground should not try to load multiple times any longer.
[*] Fixed issue where beginning Terran unlocks would keep unlocking if leaving to Main Menu then returning to Valhalla
[/list]
[b][u]Gameplay Improvements[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Tech Items (Zeno Probes, Scanners, etc...) now can be moved by the player to prevent blocking.
[*] Planetary Hazards chance now maxes out at 30 drops, instead of the previous 20 drops. Hazards now should be less... um... hazardous in the early game.
[*] Zeno Staff and Drill enemies now have a longer pause after each attack.
[*] Added secondary checks to rare conditions of game getting stuck on loading screens while transitioning between areas.
[*] Safety check on level transitions if rare condition elevators get stuck.
[*] Added safety check to rare instance of player loading in before the level as they transitioned between levels.
[*] Fallen list should now load faster and not freeze on large drop numbers
[*] Commander voice over only plays once when entering the Throne Interior
[/list]
[b][u]User Interface[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Low Health now shows a warning over the player
[*] Fixed Bio-Sensor not disappearing after an enemy had been defeated.
[*] Mining Helm numbers on resources now displays a [b]+50%[/b] icon instead of [b]x1.5[/b] text. It just looks more pretty.
[*] [b]Overheated weapons, broken weapons[/b], and [b]recovering secret[/b] now have clearer warning images vs the small text. These just look even more pretty.
[/list]
Invade Responsibly!

notes.title: Rogue Invader - New Release Date
notes.notes:
As the title says, we are going to finally release on [b]December 15th, 2021! [/b]

Testing and bug crushing has been going well. We can't wait to get it into your hands, and see how well you can invade a home-world.

End this War... on Dec 15th.

notes.title: Rogue Invader - Dev Update - Sept 17th, 2021
notes.notes:
Terrans of all kinds,

Just another update on the current development of Rogue Invader. We have been internally BETA testing for the past few weeks, and plan on a few weeks more. All features are in, and we are mainly focusing on any major bugs and balancing across the board. Specifically aiming to have the beginning of the game not too much of a grind without getting rid of the challenge.

That being said, we are having a blast (pun intended) playing it. We hope you will too very soon.

Again, big thank you for all your patience and support!

notes.title: Rogue Invader - Dev Update - May 10th, 2021
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow invaders,

We just wanted to give a quick update on the current development of Rogue Invader. We received excellent feedback about the demo during the spring Steam Game Festival. We've been hard at work implementing those suggestions along with finishing up the final features of the game (including Cloaking abilities and turning enemies to frozen ice cubes that can be used as cover).

We are very close to the official "polish" stage of the development, but want to make sure all our features are working properly before setting a new release date. We have decided to adjust the release date to Coming Soon for the time being, but are aiming for final release in 2-3 months. Expect more announcements soon as things get finished.

Big thank you for all your patience and support!

notes.title: Rogue Invader Demo! Updated Release Date!
notes.notes:
[h2]Play the Demo during the Steam Game Festival[/h2]
The Rogue Invader demo will be a part of the Steam Game Festival Feb 3rd - 9th.
Let us know what you think. Feedback is always welcome!
 
[h2]Updated Release Date - April 2021[/h2]
Due to the work on the demo, and being a small indie team, we've had to push back the release date for Rouge Invader to [u][b]early April[/b][/u]. We need more time to polish and test the features to make a fun and bug free experience. Thank you for all your support and for sticking with us throughout the development of Rogue Invader. We are excited to share the full vision of our game!
